note: LG2 battery floor (FlowBatteryCorpus): one action in every `every` of each corpus module gets one edit of each kind it has room for, with the stable seed 1; minEdits is the number of edits the run makes (measured 2026-10-11: O11 3,399 at every 6, ODC 1,724 at every 2; ODC at every 1 makes 3,469). Every edit and every undo must read back exact. o11Map: the O11 mapping battery (kind map, FlowEdits.Map: a new local of another record type filled with a mapping, then that mapping edited, then undone) over every action of the O11 corpus; measured 2026-10-12: 1,326 map and 1,326 remap edits (2,652), 1,326 undone, all exact. Review of the junction: every mandatory attribute of the target is mapped too (from an attribute of the same type, else its empty value, NullIdentifier() for an Id) and the remap never drops one, a target whose record attribute has mandatory attributes of its own is left out, and the writer refuses a mapping that leaves a mandatory attribute empty (the Verify would): so an exact edit is one the Verify takes as to its mandatory attributes; measured again 2,652 of 2,652 and 1,326 undone.
createNote: Creation battery floor (FlowBatteryCorpus.RunCreate, FlowCreateBattery): one owner in every `every` of the screens and blocks with screen or data actions gets a new action of each of those kinds from a text without @key whose header names the owner; minCreated is the number of creations by kind the run makes (measured 2026-10-12: O11 408 screen and 183 data actions on 424 Reactive and Mobile owners, 4 Traditional owners left out; ODC 110 and 4 on 110 owners). With the O11 record mapping (junction feat/texto-ssam-2) the T2 rule refuses a new For Each that only maps in O11 too, so 12 more O11 templates are refused as new actions (32 FLOW_FOREACH_LIST_ACTION in all) and 7 owners lose their only data action template: O11 408 and 176. Review of the junction: the T2 map rule is offered only where its patch keeps the loop meaning (another type, no value reading the element, nothing outside the loop), so 30 templates are refused instead of 32; measured again 408 and 176. Third junction (decision 6 on new JavaScript): an owner whose every screen action runs a JavaScript lost its creation (O11 403, ODC 109); correction 1 creates such an owner through the refusal's verified patch (the new client action, then the corrected text, both read back exact; counted in rules as "patched CODE"): O11 408 and 176, ODC 110 and 4 again. Every creation must read back exact.
